module_boundaries.:app: Android entry point, package identity, top-level navigation, theme, dependency wiring.
module_boundaries.:core:protocol: Versioned import/export, turn, LLM profile, graph, job, and validation contracts.
module_boundaries.:core:model: Shared domain models and user-visible spaces.
module_boundaries.:core:data: Room schema, DAOs, repositories, DataStore preferences, secret storage adapter, import transaction coordinator.
module_boundaries.:core:llm: Direct Android provider strategies, streaming parser, diagnostics, capability handling, future optional Python proxy interface.
module_boundaries.:feature:chat: Session list, session creation, chat timeline, composer, quote, message actions, generation presentation.
module_boundaries.:feature:memory: Context hub, anchors, notes, errors, per-session settings, native graph, global graph/insights.
module_boundaries.:feature:sources: Android file picker, source metadata, parser status, local parsers, source snippets, image sources.
module_boundaries.:feature:settings: LLM profile UI, app settings, import/export/wipe UI, diagnostics, about/update surfaces.
module_boundaries.qa/device-validation: Phase APK validation records, device matrix, screenshots or failure notes.
module_boundaries.package-release: Preview package, official package switch, signing/cover-install readiness, PWA exit evidence.

risk_areas: legacy data import corruption or uncontrolled duplication
API key leakage through storage or export
background result attached to wrong or deleted session
source parser inconsistency across file types
official package switch or signing mistake
behavior drift from Python/PWA protocol baseline
premature PWA retirement before parity evidence
release_gates: all P0 legacy entries implemented or explicitly waived
P1 entries have native path, reduced version, or no-data-loss deferral
append overwrite and new-space import modes verified
phase APK validation record exists for each requested phase APK
cover-install validation complete before com.reversetutor.app replacement
recommended_next_actions: Use execution_plan.json to create scoped module task specs.
Prepare context from architecture manifest before native files exist.
Start implementation with NATIVE-P1-001 only after user requests code work.
Require reviewer pass for high-risk data, import, LLM, background, graph, source, and package tasks.
Build codegraph after mobile-native implementation files exist.
